title: Star Source
text: Found only in the lantern chamber of a Void Lighthouse. It emits light level 15 and prevents hostile mob spawning inside a spherical radius of 64 blocks. Existing mobs are not removed; neutral creatures are unaffected.

Every 10 seconds it attempts to seed one patch of Star Scatter in a space with light below 5 and solid support beneath. Underwater positions must also be dark and supported. Seeding pauses when no suitable space remains and resumes as the surroundings change.
